workflow.name: skill_suggest
workflow.description: 技能按需建议两级编排：①jev 基于 description 快判（~1s 零 token）命中即回；②未命中 → 各技能 SKILL.md 全文+user_message 交 LLM 复核。短消息与最终无匹配静默

node.title: 扫技能+全文+短路
node.code:
import os, json, re async def main(args): um_raw = args.params.get("user_message") or "" um = re.sub(r"<pasted-log>[\s\S]*?</pasted-log>", "", um_raw).strip() cn = len(re.findall(r"[一-鿿]", um)) en = len(re.findall(r"[A-Za-z]{2,}", um)) proceed = (cn + en) >= 4 out, descs = [], [] cwd = os.getcwd() act = [] try: act = json.load(open(os.path.join(cwd, ".agent", "skills", "global-skills.json"), encoding="utf-8")) except Exception: act = [] seen = set() for root, is_global in ((os.path.join(cwd, ".agent", "skills"), False), (os.path.join(os.path.expanduser("~"), ".agt", "skills"), True)): if not os.path.isdir(root): continue for name in sorted(os.listdir(root)): sk = os.path.join(root, name, "SKILL.md") if not os.path.isfile(sk) or name in seen: continue if is_global and name not in act: continue seen.add(name) try: txt = open(sk, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").read() except Exception: continue m = re.match(r"^---\s*
(.*?)
---\s*
?(.*)$", txt, re.S) if not m: continue fm, body = m.group(1), m.group(2).strip() def g(k, fm=fm): mm = re.search("^" + k + r":\s*(.+)$", fm, re.M) return mm.group(1).strip().strip(""'") if mm else "" desc = (g("description") + ("；适用：" + g("when_to_use") if g("when_to_use") else "")).strip("； ") out.append({"name": g("name") or name, "description": desc, "when": g("when_to_use"), "full": body[:6000]}) # jev 一级 criteria 用短 description（实测拼 when 会让 0.6B 打分变平坦、全部 <0.5 漏报—— # 长信息留给二级 LLM 的 SKILL.md 全文，两级正好分工） descs.append({"name": g("name") or name, "description": g("description")}) descs.append({"name": "__none__", "description": "与以上任何技能都无关的普通对话、闲聊、提问或与本机工具无关的任务"}) return {"um": um, "proceed": proceed, "skills": out, "descs": descs, "count": len(out)}

node.title: 快判结果
node.code: async def main(args): p = args.params intent, conf = p.get("intent") or "", float(p.get("confidence") or 0) skills, um, proceed = p.get("skills") or [], p.get("um") or "", bool(p.get("proceed")) hit = proceed and intent and intent != "__none__" and conf >= 0.5 skill = next((s for s in skills if s.get("name") == intent), None) if hit and skill: result = ("🎯 匹配技能：" + skill["name"] + "（jev 置信度 " + format(conf, ".2f") + "）\n" + (skill.get("description") or "") + "\n→ 详细 SOP：read_skill(\"" + skill["name"] + "\")" + "；若需其常驻服务：skill_equip(\"" + skill["name"] + "\")") return {"hit": True, "inject": True, "result": result} return {"hit": False, "inject": False, "result": ""}

node.title: 二级复核(LLM·SKILL全文)
node.param: 你是技能调度助手：把用户消息匹配到最合适的本机技能；拿不准就答 NONE。

node.title: 二级解析
node.code: async def main(args): p = args.params ans = (p.get("answer") or "").strip() skills = p.get("skills") or [] name = ans.split()[0] if ans else "" skill = next((s for s in skills if s.get("name") == name), None) if name and name.upper() != "NONE" and skill: result = ("🎯 匹配技能：" + skill["name"] + "（LLM 复核）\n" + (skill.get("description") or "") + "\n→ 详细 SOP：read_skill(\"" + skill["name"] + "\")" + "；若需其常驻服务：skill_equip(\"" + skill["name"] + "\")") return {"inject": True, "result": result} return {"inject": False, "result": ""}
